rules.slot-syntax: A slot is {name}. The renderer fills it from the details of the cause or from a derived slot of this object.

derived.where: The place of the failed step: the cause key `where` made into text by `where-text`. Not a detail key.
derived.expression: The failed check as text: the path, the operator, and the expected value as JSON. A one-argument operator has no expected value.
derived.check: The failing check as text, for a hint: see `check`.
derived.until: The check of the poll as text, made from the detail until by the same rule as expression.
derived.in-kind: One text of in-kind-of. The detail in-kind names it.
derived.path: The first item of the detail expression.
derived.lost: One of the lost texts. A maker names it with the key (capture, context, state); the detail lost of the cause holds the text.
derived.why: One of the why texts. The detail why names it.
derived.stage: One fixed word. The detail stage holds it.
derived.worker-reason: One of the worker-reasons. The detail worker-reason holds it.
derived.op-text: One text of op-text, from the operator of the failed check.

why-of.idle: it was not used for {idle-ms} ms

hint-placeholder-docs.file: The pipeline file path relative to the project root: .zriz/pipelines/<pipeline>.json. Filled by zz and by the run page.

rules.wait-end: , until the pipeline ran out of time ({timeout-ms} ms)

op-text.count>: must have a length of more than
op-text.count>=: must have a length of at least
op-text.count<: must have a length of less than
op-text.count<=: must have a length of at most

time-budget.note: Only a two-argument operator (in ops) can check this path; the pattern needs {expected}.

where-text.name: "{name}"
where-text.no-levels: A cause with no where has no where text and no prefix: the {where}: part of a pattern is left out. There is no ? and no step number.
where-text.note: A level shows name and action only when it has them. The item part is on a for level whose item failed. It never shows the item value.

check.note: named: the detail expression is there. unnamed: it is not. of: added when the cause has a where.

found.note: count: the operators that start with count. exists: the operator exists. other: all the rest.
